# GET /api/v1/user

Get the currently authenticated user's full profile

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer|basic (required) · **ID:** `ep-125`

## Request

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — api.User

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | User ID |
| `login` | string | Username |
| `full_name` | string | Full name |
| `email` | string | Primary email (always shown for self) |
| `avatar_url` | string | Avatar URL |
| `is_admin` | boolean | Admin status (shown for self) |
| `login_name` | string | External login name (shown for self) |
| `source_id` | int64 | Auth source ID (shown for self) |
| `last_login` | datetime | Last login time (shown for self) |
| `language` | string | User language (shown for self) |
| `active` | boolean | Is active (shown for self) |
| `prohibit_login` | boolean | Login prohibited (shown for self) |

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.GetAuthenticatedUser | controller | Convert doer to API user with authed=true (self-view) |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | convert.ToUser | utility | signed=true, authed=true (doer==user); Include all private fields: IsAdmin, LoginName, SourceID, LastLogin, Language, IsActive, ProhibitLogin; Show real email regardless of KeepEmailPrivate |

**user_model.User** → **api.User** (`convert.toUser`)

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Private fields (is_admin, login_name, source_id, last_login, language, is_active, prohibit_login) only shown when authed (self or admin) | business_logic | authed (doer.ID == user.ID || doer.IsAdmin) |
| Email is hidden when user has KeepEmailPrivate=true, unless viewer is authed (self or admin) | business_logic | signed && (!user.KeepEmailPrivate || authed) |
